tasks.commands:
<<taskjs>>
(async () => {
    const { getSummaryStore } = await import('/scripts/extensions/third-party/LittleWhiteBox/modules/story-summary/data/store.js');
    const store = getSummaryStore();
    if (!store) { window.toastr?.info('ℹ️ L2 空洞检查：无 chatId'); return; }
    const events = Array.isArray(store?.json?.events) ? store.json.events : [];
    const last = Number(store?.lastSummarizedMesId ?? -1);
    if (last < 0) { window.toastr?.info('ℹ️ L2 空洞检查：还没有总结数据'); return; }

    const parenRe = /\([^)]*\)/g;
    const numRe = /\d+/g;
    const extract = (s) => {
        if (!s) return [];
        // 全角括号归一（split-join 避免嵌套回调）
        const str = String(s).split('（').join('(').split('）').join(')');
        const parens = str.match(parenRe) || [];
        const out = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < parens.length; i++) {
            const nums = parens[i].match(numRe) || [];
            for (let j = 0; j < nums.length; j += 2) {
                const a = Math.max(0, Number(nums[j]) - 1);
                const b = Math.max(a, Number(nums[j + 1] || nums[j]) - 1);
                out.push([a, b]);
            }
        }
        return out;
    };

    const covered = new Set();
    let parsedCount = 0, unparsedCount = 0;
    const unparsedSamples = [];
    for (let h = 0; h < events.length; h++) {
        const segs = extract(events[h]?.summary);
        if (segs.length === 0) {
            unparsedCount++;
            if (unparsedSamples.length < 5) {
                unparsedSamples.push({ id: events[h]?.id || '?', tail: (events[h]?.summary || '').slice(-50) });
            }
        } else {
            parsedCount++;
        }
        for (let k = 0; k < segs.length; k++) {
            const s = segs[k][0];
            const en = segs[k][1];
            for (let i = Math.max(s, 0); i <= Math.min(en, last); i++) covered.add(i);
        }
    }
    const gaps = [];
    for (let i = 0; i <= last; i++) if (!covered.has(i)) gaps.push(i);
    const evenGaps = gaps.filter(x => x % 2 === 0);
    const oddGaps  = gaps.filter(x => x % 2 === 1);

    if (gaps.length === 0) {
        window.toastr?.success('✅ L2 覆盖：' + (last + 1) + ' 楼全覆盖 ' + events.length + ' 事件');
    } else {
        window.toastr?.warning('⚠️ L2 空洞：' + gaps.length + ' 楼 ｜ 偶 ' + evenGaps.length + ' + 奇 ' + oddGaps.length + ' ｜ 解析 ' + parsedCount + '/' + events.length);
        if (unparsedSamples.length) {
            console.info('[L2 未解析 marker 样本] 共 ' + unparsedCount + ' 个：');
            console.table(unparsedSamples);
        }
        console.info('[L2 空洞] 偶数共 ' + evenGaps.length + ' 楼：' + evenGaps.join(', '));
        console.info('[L2 空洞] 奇数共 ' + oddGaps.length + ' 楼：' + oddGaps.join(', '));
    }
})().catch(err => window.toastr?.error('❌ L2 空洞检查失败: ' + (err?.message || err)));
<</taskjs>>
